definitions.gloss: leased land; rented land; land held on lease
definitions.explanation: Land that is rented from a landowner for use, typically for building a house or business. The tenant has the right to use the land but does not own it.

examples.english: I built a house on leased land.

examples.japanese: {借地|しゃくち}{料|りょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{値上|ねあ}がり→値上がり：11538_neagari⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The land lease fee increases every year.

examples.japanese: {借地|しゃくち}{権|けん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}→更新：04765_koushin⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧、⟦{地主|じぬし}→地主：12048_jinushi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: I need to negotiate with the landowner about renewing the leasehold rights.

notes:
USAGE:
An important concept in Japanese real estate. Many older homes in Japan are built on {借地|しゃくち}, especially in urban areas. The {借地|しゃくち}{権|けん} (leasehold right) is a significant legal right in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {借地|しゃくち}{権|けん} (leasehold right)
- {借地|しゃくち}{料|りょう} (land lease fee)
- {借地|しゃくち}⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧ (land lease contract)
- {借地|しゃくち}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧ (land tenant)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{借家|しゃくや}→借家：29494_shakuya⟧: rented house — the building itself rather than the land
